043package dev.visdb.seesaw.models;
044
045import java.sql.Array;
046import java.sql.JDBCType;
047import java.sql.ResultSet;
048import java.sql.SQLException;
049import java.util.Arrays;
050import java.util.Map;
051import java.util.Objects;
052
053/**
054 * Implementation of SQL array for SsList; most methods unsupported.
055 * Array data is not copied/safe.
056 */
057
058public class SsJDBCArray implements Array {
059  /**
060   * Underlying database type name for array elements
061   */
062  final private JDBCType baseType;
063
064  /**
065   * an array containing elements for an sql array
066   */
067  private Object data;
068
069  /**
070   * Creates SsJDBCArray with the object array and data base type.
071   * <em>The data is not copied</em>; the caller should not modify the array.
072   *
073   * @param data     object array of SsJDBCArray
074   * @param baseType Array elements database type
075   */
076  public SsJDBCArray(Object data, JDBCType baseType) {
077    Objects.requireNonNull(data);
078    if (!data.getClass().isArray())
079      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Must be an array");
080    this.data = data;
081    this.baseType = baseType;
082  }
083
084  /** {@inheritDoc } */
085  @Override
086  public void free() throws SQLException {
087    data = null;
088  }
089
090  /** {@inheritDoc } */
091  @Override
092  public Object getArray() throws SQLException {
093    return data;
094  }
095
096  /**
097   * throws UnsupportedOperationException
098   * {@inheritDoc }
099   */
100  @Override
101  public Object getArray(long index, int count) throws SQLException {
102    throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
103  }
104
105  /**
106   * throws UnsupportedOperationException
107   * {@inheritDoc }
108   */
109  @Override
110  public Object getArray(long index, int count, Map<String, Class<?>> map) throws SQLException {
111    throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
112  }
113
114  /**
115   * throws UnsupportedOperationException
116   * {@inheritDoc }
117   */
118  @Override
119  public Object getArray(Map<String, Class<?>> map) throws SQLException {
120    throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
121  }
122
123  /** {@inheritDoc } */
124  @Override
125  public int getBaseType() throws SQLException {
126    return baseType.getVendorTypeNumber();
127  }
128
129  /** {@inheritDoc } */
130  @Override
131  public String getBaseTypeName() throws SQLException {
132    return baseType.getName();
133  }
134
135  /**
136   * throws UnsupportedOperationException
137   * {@inheritDoc }
138   */
139  @Override
140  public ResultSet getResultSet() throws SQLException {
141    throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
142  }
143
144  /**
145   * throws UnsupportedOperationException
146   * {@inheritDoc }
147   */
148  @Override
149  public ResultSet getResultSet(long index, int count) throws SQLException {
150    throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
151  }
152
153  /**
154   * throws UnsupportedOperationException
155   * {@inheritDoc }
156   */
157  @Override
158  public ResultSet getResultSet(long index, int count, Map<String, Class<?>> map)
159      throws SQLException {
160    throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
161  }
162
163  /**
164   * throws UnsupportedOperationException
165   * {@inheritDoc }
166   */
167  @Override
168  public ResultSet getResultSet(Map<String, Class<?>> map) throws SQLException {
169    throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
170  }
171
172  /**
173   * Returns a string value with comma separated values. e.g. "{100,200,300}"
174   * @return
175   */
176  @Override
177  public String toString() {
178    String text = "SsJDBCArray " + Arrays.asList(data);
179    return text;
180  }
181}
